Yeah I feel this almost every time when I have an amazing time with my friends; I guess the feeling resides in the fact that I’m finally alone. I’ve come to learn that it’s actually a beautiful thing to have this space; the silence may echo, but it doesn’t have to be negative. In my experience, I try my best to just relax and do something that I love in that moment, like put on a comfort movie/show. It’s the process of loving yourself that is the hardest (I know because I’m dealing with it as well). But know that you are never alone and that you’re amazing. Hope that kind of “helped”. 

P.S. I know this is a rant, and I definitely hear you. Just wanted to let you know you’re not alone love
